incidents.name: Creat Future CF token public _transfer
incidents.notes: The CF token exposed its internal _transfer(address,address,uint256) as a public function with no access control, so anyone could move CF out of the CF/USDT pair and drain it.

sources.ref: onchain review: CF token 0x8B7218CF6Ac641382D7C723dE8aA173e98a80196 created 2022-04-08T16:53:33Z by 0xa8713cad381ea4c86fafb9bab53aed23d2af4a34, unrelated to attack sender 0xee0221d76504aec40f63ad7e36855eebf5ea5edd; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. DeFiHackLabs reports ~$1.9M but that is a nominal token figure; the CF/USDT pair held 250,102 USDT at block 16841994, which bounds the realised loss and still clears the $1,000 floor, so lossUsd is left null.
